moons.title: Deliver a product from one paragraph at a fixed, warrantied price
Keep code as a regenerable cache of intent clauses and proofs
Run an owner-less project under a charter until an heir takes over
Own the pager for insured crash classes, from trace to proven fix
Merge any agent's pull request on rerun proofs, not prose review
Predict a policy change's effect from the ledger before running it
Forecast when each gate stops paying, and retire it on evidence
Pool self-trials across installs
Settle work between strangers by escrow released on replayed proof
Detect when a mechanism needs redesign, not another patch
Auction the queue by calibrated yield and Kelly-size each stake
Weight deciders by a scored market on whether a close survives
Price the user's attention and cap unreviewed output to it
Breed lane strategies by tournament, with heritable genomes
Spawn every child with expiring capability tokens and no inheritance
Open a warranty window on landed work and count hand edits as claims
Ship every close as a signed evidence bundle anyone can rerun
Prove a rewrite against the old build on recorded inputs
Hold every self-promotion to a false-discovery bar
Put a backtested p90 band on every cost quote
Cut a codebase in half and grow two whole programs back
Grow antibodies against bugs nobody has written yet
Sleep nightly, dream counterfactual workdays, and wake up a better engineer
Make every module a living cell that defends, negotiates and divides
Eat your dependencies and keep only proven organelles
